name: Robotics HAL & Actuator Destruction Guard
purpose: Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL) for robotic actuators, sensor fusion, motor kinematic limits, and physical destruction boundary enforcement.
registration: RoboticsHal::new enumerates connected hardware; DestructionGuard::new compiles physical bounds.
discovery: Hardware bus scan for serial, I2C, and USB motor controllers.
storage: In-memory telemetry logs and kinematic calibration profiles.
memory_link: Physical interaction outcomes logged in episodic memory.
learning_link: Actuator trajectory accuracy calibrated over operation cycles.
self_evolution_link: Hardware profile adaptively adjusts torque limits based on mechanical wear.
curriculum_link: Robotics kinematics and physics records in master_curriculum.jsonl.
safety_gates: Physical Destruction Guard: Hard velocity, torque, and positional bounds cannot be breached
Hardware emergency stop interlock immediately terminates power on anomaly detection

lifecycle.1_scan: Enumerate available robotic joints, sensors, and actuators
lifecycle.2_calibrate: Load kinematic boundary limits and emergency stop pin mappings
lifecycle.3_plan: Cognitive loop proposes motion trajectory for physical task
lifecycle.4_guard: DestructionGuard simulates trajectory to ensure zero boundary violation
lifecycle.5_execute: RoboticsHal issues step pulses / PWM commands to motor controllers
lifecycle.6_feedback: Sensor fusion verifies actual encoder position matches target trajectory
lifecycle.7_interlock: If unexpected resistance or collision detected, trigger emergency stop
